recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血液抹片中，散在的嗜中性球外圍多有淡紫色血小板環繞成小花環，而背景中游離血小板稀少，全片規律出現這種現象即為 EDTA 相關的血小板衛星現象。
features: Low-power field with evenly spread normocytic red cells
Scattered neutrophils, many rimmed by small rosettes of adherent platelets
Few free platelets in the intervening background
No free platelet clumps or schistocytes; detail limited at this power
describe_en: Low-power view of a peripheral blood smear shows evenly distributed normocytic red cells with scattered leukocytes. Many neutrophils are rimmed by small rosettes of adherent platelets, whereas occasional lymphocytes lack platelet adherence and free platelets are sparse in the background. Free platelet clumps and schistocytes are not seen. Fine platelet and leukocyte morphology cannot be assessed at this magnification. Findings are consistent with EDTA-dependent platelet satellitism causing pseudothrombocytopenia; recollection in sodium citrate is recommended.

ddx.vs: ITP shows genuinely decreased platelets without platelets ringing neutrophils.
Platelet clumps float free of leukocytes and are often concentrated at the feathered edge.
Microangiopathy shows schistocytes with true thrombocytopenia, which are absent here.
